critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a radial transformation to the main deck window array: instead of a linear Y-axis distribution, map the window positions along a cylindrical arc with a radius matching the fuselage curvature. Adjust the spacing parameter so that windows are equidistant along this arc, ensuring they follow the aircraft's body contour rather than a flat horizontal plane.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous row of small dots on the upper hump.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct, slightly curved horizontal row of windows following the hump's contour.

discrepancies.observed: No visible recessed lines or frames for doors.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular indentations and seams around passenger doors.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add thin extruded planes for door frames

discrepancies.observed: Windows are placed in a perfectly straight horizontal line across the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Windows follow the slight curvature of the aircraft's cylindrical body.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: curve window positions along the cylinder arc

discrepancies.observed: A flat, single-plane surface for the cockpit windows.
discrepancies.reference: A multi-faceted, recessed glass structure with distinct structural frames.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: extrude and bevel cockpit window faces
